Name: RenamedDerivedTable
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: RenamedDerivedTable, command: many)
SELECT r.book, r.writer FROM (SELECT id, author_id FROM books) AS r (book, writer) WHERE r.writer = $1;
Template: SELECT ⟨c0:r.book⟩, ⟨c1:r.writer⟩ FROM (SELECT id, author_id FROM books) AS r (book, writer) WHERE r.writer = ⟨p0⟩;⟨arguments p0⟩

Name: PartlyRenamedCTE
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: PartlyRenamedCTE, command: many)
WITH t (book) AS (SELECT id, title FROM books) SELECT book, title FROM t;
Template: WITH t (book) AS (SELECT id, title FROM books) SELECT ⟨c0:book⟩, ⟨c1:title⟩ FROM t;

Name: RenamedStarCTE
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: RenamedStarCTE, command: many)
WITH t (key, label) AS (SELECT * FROM authors) SELECT key, label FROM t;
Template: WITH t (key, label) AS (SELECT * FROM authors) SELECT ⟨c0:key⟩, ⟨c1:label⟩ FROM t;

Name: RenamedValues
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: RenamedValues, command: many)
SELECT v.n, v.label FROM (VALUES (1, 'one'), (2, 'two')) AS v (n, label);

Name: AuthorTitles
NestedWith
StarOfAnEarlierCTE
Template: WITH first_rows AS (SELECT id, name FROM authors), second_rows AS (SELECT * FROM first_rows)\nSELECT ⟨star written 0=second_rows.id 1=second_rows.name:*⟩ FROM second_rows;

Name: JoinedEarlierCTE
Template: WITH named AS (SELECT id, name FROM authors), titled AS (SELECT b.title, n.name FROM books b JOIN named n ON n.id = b.author_id)\nSELECT ⟨c0:title⟩, ⟨c1:name⟩ FROM titled;

Name: CTEInsideADerivedUnion
Template: WITH a AS (SELECT id, name FROM authors)\nSELECT ⟨c0:u.id⟩, ⟨c1:u.name⟩ FROM (SELECT id, name FROM a UNION ALL SELECT id, name FROM a) u;

Name: DerivedTableInALaterArm
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: DerivedTableInALaterArm, command: many)
SELECT id, name FROM authors UNION ALL SELECT d.id, d.title FROM (SELECT id, title FROM books) d;
Template: SELECT id, name FROM authors UNION ALL SELECT d.id, d.title FROM (SELECT id, title FROM books) d;

Name: LateralInsideACTE
AuthorsWithFirstTitle
Template: SELECT ⟨c0:a.id⟩, ⟨c1:(SELECT b.title FROM books b WHERE b.author_id = a.id ORDER BY b.id LIMIT 1)⟩, ⟨c2 aliased:(SELECT max(b.price) FROM books b WHERE b.author_id = a.id)⟩ AS top_price\nFROM authors a;

Name: AuthorsAboveCount
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: AuthorsAboveCount, command: many)
SELECT a.id FROM authors a WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM books b WHERE b.author_id = a.id) > $1;
Template: SELECT ⟨c0:a.id⟩ FROM authors a WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM books b WHERE b.author_id = a.id) > ⟨p0⟩;⟨arguments p0⟩

Name: NullInTheFirstBranch
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: NullInTheFirstBranch, command: many)
SELECT NULL AS name UNION ALL SELECT name FROM authors;
Template: SELECT NULL AS name UNION ALL SELECT name FROM authors;
